title: Jev task routing policy configuration
description: Schema for jev_task_routing.json (v2.5.5-draft) and the runtime objects it defines. Model settings live in models.json (models.schema.json); the policy only references them.

roles.description: Exactly the registered delegated roles. Keys are role IDs; coordinator/final-verifier are retired and must not appear.

default_mode.description: There is deliberately no fallback testing mode (VER-1).

evidence_orders.description: Positive dispatch triggers and contracts for inspector/researcher. Without this section those roles are defined only by exclusion and are never dispatched (v2.4.0 defect).

request.description: Host -> router request. Assembled only by the host; trusted_flags and testing_evidence are never taken from issue text or model output.

workOrder.description: A host-issued assignment. A template instance (all null/empty) is unissued; the executor must bind order_id/order_revision to its authenticated dispatch record before launch (ORDER-1).

evidence_gap.description: For inspector/researcher orders: the specific gap (trigger id + question) the order must close.

launch_channel.description: The only permitted launch channel (ORDER-9). Subagent/background execution is rejected by schema.

pane_id.description: Herdr pane id, filled by the host after launch.
